title: BcDeviceAssignPageInput
description: Place an already-commissioned (pending) device on a dashboard page after the fact. Generates the device's widgets on the page and flips its status from `pending` to `provisioned`. Supply an existing `page_id` OR `new_page: { name }` (created on demand under the device's site). `tenant_id` is bound by the host and cannot be supplied.

device_id.description: The device to place (must already exist).

page_id.description: Existing page to hang the device's widgets on.

new_page.description: Create a page on demand (under the device's site) and place the device on it.
